tips.text: Bring a frame that clears whole rooms alone, such as Mirage, Saryn, Volt, Gara, Khora, Atlas, Voruna or Valkyr.
Cast your nuke about every 10 seconds instead of on cooldown so Elite does not disable it.
Squad up through recruiting chat; public lobbies are mostly players who leave after zone 2 or 3.
Use Mirage with Explosive Legerdemain for the long passive grind.
Restart after zone 6 (A, A, B) if your efficiency dies early; every part drops in all three rotations.
Run Elite as your Focus farm; the parts fall out of the same runs.
Expect duplicates from ordinary Focus or levelling runs; the farm is easy now.
